name: AnalyticsDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/AnalyticsDashboard
summary: The analytics dashboard pattern: KPI tiles, charts and a table that all read the same period, so one change of range moves every region together: the Period Select in the PageHeader actions sets the comparison of every delta and the period in each exported CSV name. A row of four StatTiles (requests, data transferred, success rate and status 5xx, each with a sparkline and its change against the previous period) sits over a 12-column grid of ChartCards. Requests over time spans the grid as an area Chart, status codes as a multi-series line and requests by country as labeled horizontal bars share a row, and a searchable, paginated DataTable of top hosts closes it. Every card carries the same header: title with a Hint, the aggregation and variation Tags, a Line or Bar ToggleGroup for time series, an Expand IconButton that opens the card in a large Dialog, and a DropdownMenu whose Copy query copies the card's GraphQL query and Export CSV downloads its rows, each confirmed by a toast. Built from `PageHeader`, `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `DataTable`, `Tag`, `Hint`, `ToggleGroup`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, `Dialog`, `toast`, `Input` and `EmptyState`. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the first response loads, every tile, chart and the table hold their place with a Skeleton, so the grid does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No traffic in the period. The tiles show a dash with no delta or trend, and each card keeps its box with an EmptyState that says nothing was recorded.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The request for the period failed: the tiles read as dashes, and every card keeps its header with a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.

variants.name: Metrics
variants.summary: Real-time metrics per product: a PageTabs strip switches between Applications, Functions, Firewall, DNS and Data stream, and a Period Select in the page header (Last hour, Last 24 hours, Last 7 days, Last 30 days) drives every region. Each product shows its own four StatTiles with sparkline and change against the previous period, over four ChartCards of area, line or stacked bar Charts that share one crosshair. Products with more than one dashboard add a ToggleGroup under the tabs: Applications switches between Overview, Status codes (the status card over a status and upstream status table with search and an All, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx status-class filter) and Request breakdown (an IP address table with search); Firewall adds Denied sources. Every card menu copies its GraphQL query and exports its rows as CSV.

variants.name: Expanded
variants.summary: The Requests over time card opened from its Expand button: a large Dialog with the card title and its description, the Line or Bar ToggleGroup shared with the card, and the chart at a 420px plot (the table card opens with ten rows per page). Closing it returns focus to Expand. Every card's menu works: Copy query copies the card's GraphQL query and Export CSV downloads its rows, each confirmed by a toast.

variants.name: MetricsOverview
variants.summary: The real-time metrics landing page across products: a Period Select and a Refresh button in the page header, six StatTiles (requests, data transferred, cache offload, status 5xx, requests denied, function invocations) with sparkline and change, and six highlight ChartCards from Applications, Firewall and Functions. Each card keeps the full header (Sum Tag, Line or Bar ToggleGroup, Expand into a large Dialog, Copy query and Export CSV) and ends in a footer Link to its product dashboard (Open Applications dashboard).
